title: Mega Great League
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.

title: Mega Ultra League
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter.

title: Master Premier Cup
rules: Legendary Pokémon, Mythical Pokémon, and Ultra Beasts are not eligible.

title: BF Spectral
rules: Only Bug, Ghost, Ice, Poison, and Psychic types are eligible. Dark, Normal, Rock, and Steel types are not eligible.
Legendary Pokémon, Mythical Pokémon, and Ultra Beasts are not eligible.

Banned: Annihilape, Araquanid, Armarouge, Clodsire, Galarian Corsola, Dusclops, Dusknoir, Frillish, Golett, Golurk, Jellicent, Lapras, Alolan Marowak, Mimikyu, Sealeo, Spidops, Toxapex, Toxtricity, Hisuian Typhlosion, Walrein.

title: BF UL
rules: Only Bug, Dark, Fairy, Ghost, and Poison types are eligible, plus: Charizard, Mega Charizard X, Mega Charizard Y, Sandslash, Ninetales, Rapidash, Seaking, Typhlosion, Blaziken, Mega Blaziken, Camerupt, Samurott, Reshiram, Delphox, Talonflame, Turtonator, Greedent, Ursaluna.
Mega Evolutions are eligible (Mega Camerupt is not at 2,500 CP). Mega Delphox is not eligible.
Banned: Nidoqueen, Tentacruel, Forretress, Mega Mawile, Crustle, Mega Greninja, Mimikyu, Guzzlord, Tinkaton, Kingambit.

title: Haymaker
rules: Only Bug, Fairy, Fighting, Ice, Normal, Psychic, and Steel types are eligible; Articuno, Goodra, and Gyarados are airdrops.
All Flying types are banned except the airdrops.

Banned: Mega Chesnaught, Mega Delphox, Mega Heracross, Mega Latias, Mega Latios, Mega Metagross, Mega Mewtwo X, Mega Mewtwo Y, Latias, Latios, Lunala, Marshadow, Mewtwo, Necrozma Dawn Wings, Xerneas, and Zacian (Crowned Sword).

title: Ericcsonns Meta
rules: Banned: Necrozma Dusk Mane, Necrozma Dawn Wings, Mega Gyarados, Mega Garchomp, Mega Metagross, Mega Dragonite, Mega Tyranitar, Mega Salamence, Mega Greninja, Mega Chesnaught, Mega Delphox, Mega Swampert, Mega Heracross, and Mega Charizard Y.

Airdrops: Regigigas, Latios, Heatran, Darkrai, Terrakion, Origin Forme Giratina, Therian Forme Thundurus, Volcanion, Rapid Strike and Single Strike Urshifu, Melmetal, Kyurem, Galarian Articuno, Incarnate Forme Landorus, Galarian Zapdos, Zapdos, Latias, Tapu Lele, Entei, Moltres, Raikou, Incarnate Forme Enamorus, Tapu Bulu, Zeraora, Therian Forme Enamorus, Altered Forme Giratina, Genesect, Mew, Celebi, Jirachi, Victini, Armored Mewtwo, and Galarian Moltres.
